a.lede: Google's Gemini could soon access any file on your macOS device, open apps, browse the web, and perform actions without asking for permission every time. [...]
a.title: Google Gemini could soon get full access to your Mac’s files, apps and the web

b.lede: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.
b.title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
